infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ZoneCam uses the camera to document job sites.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ZoneCam uses the microphone when recording job-site video.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ZoneCam can attach the job location to a photo when you allow it. Location is not tracked continuously.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Attach this photo’s location to the job record. ZoneCam does not track you in the background.
